text:
Rami: ran through the new quickstart during onboarding workshop. First call printed a few tokens, then the client raised an error and the app showed "permission_denied". Super confusing to students.
Priya: which SDK + sample? can you paste the exact curl or repro steps?
Rami: redwood-node 0.6.0, starter-convo example. Repro with curl: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/chat/generate?stream=true" -d '{"input":"hello"}'` — gets a few SSE chunks then `{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"attach a payment method to continue"}}`. The app mapped that to permission_denied which misled everyone.
onboard-bot: Heads up: workspace 'team-alpha' trial expired 2 days ago. Streaming is gated until billing is attached: https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/team-alpha/billing
qa-bot: logs show initial 200 handshake then an injected 402 chunk. Header `x-rw-reason: billing_required` present. Some proxies surface the control event after the first data chunks which explains partial output.
mika: thanks for the details. Two issues here: (1) SDK error mapping flattened billing_required -> permission_denied; (2) streaming clients open SSE/WS before checking billing status so you can see partial tokens.
Priya: for the workshop I switched demos to `stream=false` and the 402 shows up immediately which made the failure easy to explain. Short-term tip for docs: recommend non-streaming for demos when billing not configured.
Rami: can the SDKs be made to do a cheap preflight `GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status` before starting a long-lived stream? That would avoid half-baked output.
mika: filing DX ticket RD-4680 to add an optional precheck in all stream clients and to stop mapping billing_required to permission_denied. Also changing retry logic so we do not retry on explicit client errors like billing.
Priya: another parity note: python and browser SDKs already have a preflight hook, looks like node and CLI missed it. Can we sync parity across SDKs?
qa-bot: adding test coverage: stub billing_status to return trial_expired and assert stream client fails fast with a clear `billing_required` error, not partial tokens.
Rami: thanks, that should fix future workshops. For now I updated the quickstart README to mention the billing precheck and included a small snippet showing a graceful fallback to a lightweight model if billing_required is returned.
mika: we'll also change the CLI to surface raw error bodies for first-call failures instead of the generic mapped message so demos are clearer.
Rami: appreciated. Leaving the failing curl + captured chunks in this thread in case someone wants to triage further.
